purpose: Define the gate between reviewed evidence artifacts and any Human Infra quantitative model input. The contract prevents Source/variable/endpoint/uncertainty/transfer/downgrade artifacts from being silently promoted into calibrated predictors, intervention effects or individual claims.

included: admission levels for narrative evidence, bounded reviewed artifacts, variable candidates, synthetic toy models, aggregate calibrated research models and individual decision support
minimum gates for converting reviewed artifacts into model variables or scenario parameters
hard abort gates that keep evidence out of any model regardless of narrative value
current repository decision for B1-B5 reviewed artifacts and the life-path model pipeline
excluded: calibration claim without governed real data and validation

admissionLevels.name: narrative-hypothesis
admissionLevels.allowedUse: May appear in explanatory prose, route maps or research questions only.

admissionLevels.name: bounded-reviewed-artifact
admissionLevels.allowedUse: May support bounded Source, variable, endpoint, uncertainty, transfer-boundary or downgrade artifacts after fresh review.

admissionLevels.name: model-candidate-variable
admissionLevels.allowedUse: May be listed as a candidate variable, endpoint, uncertainty channel or downgrade trigger for a future model design.

admissionLevels.name: synthetic-toy-model-input
admissionLevels.allowedUse: May enter synthetic scenarios or stress tests if the output is labeled synthetic and not calibrated.

admissionLevels.name: aggregate-calibrated-research-model
admissionLevels.allowedUse: May support aggregate scenario-level research estimates after governed data access, exact variable confirmation, extraction, weighting, disclosure control, validation and calibration diagnostics.

admissionLevels.name: individual-decision-support
admissionLevels.allowedUse: Blocked by default in this repository.
minimumEvidence: external clinical and ethical governance beyond this repository
blockedUses: insurance employment credit policing or coercive ranking

minimumAdmissionGates.name: Source identity and fresh review
minimumAdmissionGates.passCondition: The source has stable identity, accessible trace, reviewer verdict, exact-claim use and blocked-use boundary.

minimumAdmissionGates.name: Model location
minimumAdmissionGates.passCondition: The candidate declares whether it affects state transition, hazard, observation process, action policy, time accounting or governance boundary.

minimumAdmissionGates.name: Estimand and comparator
minimumAdmissionGates.passCondition: Population, time zero, intervention or exposure, comparator, outcome, horizon and censoring rule are explicit.

minimumAdmissionGates.name: Governed data access
minimumAdmissionGates.passCondition: The dataset access tier, registration status, allowed files, storage boundary and destruction rule are recorded.

minimumAdmissionGates.name: Exact variable and value confirmation
minimumAdmissionGates.passCondition: Exact fields, value labels, missing codes, question text, universe or skip logic and route-value crosswalk are confirmed from official sources.

minimumAdmissionGates.name: Reproducible extraction and cohort flow
minimumAdmissionGates.passCondition: A governed extractor emits aggregate cohort-flow outputs without row-level data exposure.

minimumAdmissionGates.name: Validation and calibration
minimumAdmissionGates.passCondition: Internal validation, external validation plan or result, calibration diagnostics and sensitivity analysis are present.

minimumAdmissionGates.name: Governance and prohibited use
minimumAdmissionGates.passCondition: The artifact explicitly blocks individual death dates, individual medical advice, coercive ranking and clinical claims outside its evidence grade.

hardAbortGates.condition: Source identity, version, access route or traceability is missing.
A biomarker-only or mechanism-only result is converted into lifespan, mortality or effective-time effect without endpoint evidence.
Animal, in vitro or computational evidence is used as a human calibrated effect estimate.
Comparator, time zero, target population or horizon is absent for a quantitative intervention claim.
The output includes individual death date, individual life expectancy, individual medical advice or individual eligibility ranking.
Raw controlled or sensitive data would enter public artifacts, public AI systems or uncontrolled storage.

currentRepositoryDecision.highestAllowedLevelBoundary: Synthetic toy scenarios and public aggregate mortality anchors are allowed only for sanity checks and visualization; they are not calibrated prediction evidence.
currentRepositoryDecision.currentC2ReviewedArtifactsBoundary: B1-B5 reviewed artifacts can define candidate variables, endpoints, uncertainty channels, transfer boundaries and downgrade triggers, but none is admitted as a calibrated model parameter or intervention effect.
currentRepositoryDecision.nextDecisionNeeded: Create a model-admission candidate registry only after selecting a narrow estimand and confirming exact variables, value labels, cohort flow, survey design and disclosure control.

artifactBridge.requiredStatement: Reviewed artifacts are evidence-boundary objects, not model parameters. A separate admission decision is required before any artifact changes a hazard, transition, observation, policy or time-accounting parameter.

standardsTrace.localRole: Prediction-model reporting anchor for transparent intended use, predictors, outcomes, validation and limitations.
standardsTrace.localBoundary: Reporting anchor only; current repository outputs do not satisfy calibrated clinical prediction standards.

standardsTrace.localRole: Risk-of-bias and applicability review anchor for future prediction model studies.
standardsTrace.localBoundary: Bias-review anchor only; no low-bias prediction claim exists without real study design and data.

standardsTrace.localRole: Engineering reference for patient-level prediction lifecycle concepts.
standardsTrace.localBoundary: Reference only; Human Infra does not currently run an OHDSI PLP model.

standardsTrace.localRole: Causal-question discipline for intervention, comparator, time zero and follow-up.
standardsTrace.localBoundary: Method anchor only; not evidence that any Human Infra intervention effect is identified.

nextWorkOrders.item: Build a model-admission candidate registry that maps selected reviewed artifacts to L1/L2/L3/L4 decisions without opening calibrated admission.
Execute NHATS Colectica value-label review protocol and fill field-level source trace, route-value crosswalk and missing-code map.
Promote only fully confirmed aggregate fields into a pre-extraction cohort-flow implementation after data access and disclosure gates pass.
